senses.gloss:
भूधन m. (-नः) A king.
 E. भू the earth, and धन wealth.

भूधर m. (-रः)
 1. A mountain.
 2. A kind of chemical or medicinal ap-
paratus; a sand bath in which a covered crucible is placed, and
the fire is lighted above as well as below it.
 3. The number
“seven.”
 E. भू earth, धृ to support, aff. अप् ।

भूध्र m. (-ध्रः) A mountain.
 E. भू the earth, धृ to hold, aff. अप्, and the
vowel changed to its analogous semi-vowel.
